title: dot、归约与扫描：块级计算与 combine_fn 变 IR region
one_line: 两大块级计算主题：① tl.dot 的形状/dtype 校验 + 后端能力钩子(min_dot_size/input_precision/acc-dtype)如何共同决定命不命中 Tensor Core；② reduce/associative_scan/histogram 如何把用户传入的 combine_fn 经 _generator 回调重新驱动 CodeGenerator，把 Python 函数体再编译成 create_reduce/create_scan 的 IR region body。
reader_payoff: 本章解锁的性能杠杆：你的 tl.dot 到底命不命中 Tensor Core——由 min_dot_size(后端声明的最小 tile) + input_precision(tf32/ieee) + acc/out_dtype 三者共同决定，读者据此判断自己的 dot 写法。

embed_excerpts.what: semantic.dot：本章 stakes 核心。校验闸门(dtype→precision→形状→min_dot_size 后端钩子)+acc/ret dtype 选型+create_dot
embed_excerpts.code:
def dot(lhs: tl.tensor, rhs: tl.tensor, acc: tl.tensor, input_precision: Optional[str], max_num_imprecise_acc: int,
        out_dtype: tl.dtype, builder: ir.builder) -> tl.tensor:
    assert lhs.type.is_block() and rhs.type.is_block()

    if lhs.dtype.is_fp8() and rhs.dtype.is_fp8():
        # All combinations of supported fp8 x fp8 are permitted
        pass
    else:
        assert lhs.dtype in (tl.int8, tl.uint8, tl.float16, tl.bfloat16,
                             tl.float32), f"Unsupported lhs dtype {lhs.dtype}"
        assert rhs.dtype in (tl.int8, tl.uint8, tl.float16, tl.bfloat16,
                             tl.float32), f"Unsupported rhs dtype {rhs.dtype}"
        assert lhs.dtype == rhs.dtype, f"Both operands must be same dtype. Got {lhs.dtype} and {rhs.dtype}"

    if lhs.dtype.is_fp8e4b15() or rhs.dtype.is_fp8e4b15():
        lhs = cast(lhs, tl.float16, builder)
        rhs = cast(rhs, tl.float16, builder)

    if input_precision is None:
        input_precision = builder.options.default_dot_input_precision

    input_precision = _str_to_dot_input_precision(input_precision, builder)

    lhs_rank = len(lhs.shape)
    rhs_rank = len(rhs.shape)
    assert lhs_rank == rhs_rank == 2 or lhs_rank == rhs_rank == 3, f"Both inputs must be either 2D or 3D; (lhs: {lhs.shape} vs rhs: {rhs.shape})"
    assert lhs.shape[-1].value == rhs.shape[
        -2].value, f"First input shape ({lhs.shape}) and second input shape {rhs.shape} are not compatible for matmul ..."
    assert builder.codegen_fns.get("min_dot_size") is not None, "target doesn't provide lower shape bounds for dot."
    min_dot_size = builder.codegen_fns["min_dot_size"](lhs.type, rhs.type)
    assert lhs.shape[-2].value >= min_dot_size[0] and lhs.shape[-1].value >= min_dot_size[2] \
        and rhs.shape[-1].value >= min_dot_size[1], \
            f"Input shapes should have M >= {min_dot_size[0]}, N >= {min_dot_size[1]} and K >= {min_dot_size[2]}"
    if lhs.type.scalar.is_int():
        assert lhs.type.scalar == tl.int8, "only int8 supported!"
        _0 = builder.get_int32(0)
        ret_scalar_ty = tl.int32
    elif out_dtype.is_bf16():
        raise ValueError(
            "out_dtype=bfloat16 is unsupported. Please use out_dtype=float32/float16 and cast with `.to(tl.bfloat16)`")
    elif lhs.type.scalar.is_fp32() or lhs.type.scalar.is_bf16():
        _0 = builder.get_fp32(0)
        ret_scalar_ty = tl.float32
    else:
        _0 = builder.get_fp16(0) if out_dtype.is_fp16() else builder.get_fp32(0)
        ret_scalar_ty = out_dtype

    M = lhs.type.shape[-2]
    N = rhs.type.shape[-1]
    K = lhs.type.shape[-1]
    B = lhs.type.shape[0] if lhs_rank == 3 else None
    ret_ty = tl.block_type(ret_scalar_ty, [B, M, N] if B else [M, N])
    if acc is None:
        acc_handle = builder.create_splat(_0, [B, M, N] if B else [M, N])
    else:
        acc_handle = acc.handle
        assert acc.type == ret_ty

    # max_num_imprecise_acc only applies to fp8 -> fp32 dot on sm_90
    if max_num_imprecise_acc is None:
        if lhs.dtype.is_fp8() and rhs.dtype.is_fp8():
            max_num_imprecise_acc = builder.options.max_num_imprecise_acc_default
        else:
            max_num_imprecise_acc = 0
    else:
        if lhs.dtype.is_fp8() and rhs.dtype.is_fp8() and max_num_imprecise_acc > K:
            raise ValueError(f"max_num_imprecise_acc ({max_num_imprecise_acc}) must be <= K ({K})")

    return tl.tensor(builder.create_dot(lhs.handle, rhs.handle, acc_handle, input_precision, max_num_imprecise_acc),
                     ret_ty)

embed_excerpts.what: semantic.reduction：造 create_reduce op、让 region_builder_fn(=make_combine_region) 填 region body、verify、按结果形状包 tensor
embed_excerpts.code:
def reduction(inputs: Sequence[tl.tensor], axis: int, region_builder_fn, builder: ir.builder) -> Tuple[tl.tensor, ...]:
    if axis is None:
        inputs = tuple(reshape(t, [t.numel.value], can_reorder=True, builder=builder) for t in inputs)
        axis = 0
    # get result shape
    shape = inputs[0].type.shape
    rank = len(shape)
    assert axis < rank, f"reduction axis must be < inputs rank ({rank})"
    ret_shape = [s for i, s in enumerate(shape) if i != axis]
    assert all(t.type.shape == shape for t in inputs), "all reduction inputs must have the same shape"

    reduce_op = builder.create_reduce([t.handle for t in inputs], axis)
    region_builder_fn(reduce_op)
    reduce_op.verify()

    return tuple(wrap_tensor(reduce_op.get_result(i), inputs[i].type.scalar, ret_shape) for i in range(len(inputs)))

def call_JitFunction(self, fn: JITFunction, args, kwargs):
        args = inspect.getcallargs(fn.fn, *args, **kwargs)
        args = [args[name] for name in fn.arg_names]
        args = [arg if _is_triton_value(arg) else constexpr(arg) for arg in args]
        ...
        fn_name = mangle_fn(fn.__name__, arg_types, constants)
        # generate function def if necessary
        if not self.module.has_function(fn_name):
            prototype = language.function_type([], arg_types)
            gscope = fn.__globals__
            file_name, begin_line = get_jit_fn_file_line(fn)
            generator = CodeGenerator(self.context, prototype, gscope, attributes, constants, module=self.module,
                                      jit_fn=fn, function_name=fn_name, function_types=self.function_ret_types,
                                      noinline=fn.noinline, file_name=file_name, begin_line=begin_line,
                                      options=self.builder.options, codegen_fns=self.builder.codegen_fns,
                                      module_map=self.builder.module_map)
            generator.visit(fn.parse())
            ...

embed_excerpts.what: _reduce_with_indices：argmax/argmin 的支撑。造 arange 索引、跨非归约轴 expand+broadcast，把 (值,索引) 作为一对 tensor 一起归约 —— combine_fn 于是能同时挑值和对应索引
embed_excerpts.code:
def _reduce_with_indices(input, axis, combine_fn, keep_dims=False, _builder=None, _generator=None):
    axis = _constexpr_to_value(axis)
    n = input.shape[axis]
    index = arange(0, n, _builder=_builder)

    if len(input.shape) > 1:
        # Broadcast index across the non-reduced axes
        axes_to_expand = [constexpr(d) for d in builtins.range(len(input.shape))]
        del axes_to_expand[axis]
        index = expand_dims(index, axes_to_expand, _builder=_builder)
        index = broadcast_to(index, input.shape, _builder=_builder)

    rvalue, rindices = reduce((input, index), axis, combine_fn, keep_dims=keep_dims, _builder=_builder,
                              _generator=_generator)
    return rvalue, rindices

data_flow: ① tl.dot 路径：core.dot 定 input_precision 默认 → semantic.dot 校验 dtype/形状 → assert builder.codegen_fns['min_dot_size'] 取后端最小 tile → 校验 M/N/K ≥ min → 定 ret_scalar_ty(int8→int32 / fp32|bf16→fp32 / 其余看 out_dtype) → acc 缺省 splat 0 → 定 max_num_imprecise_acc(fp8 才非零) → builder.create_dot 出 tt.dot IR
② dot_scaled 路径：core.dot_scaled(仅 out_dtype=float32) → semantic.dot_scaled 校验 MX 格式枚举/K≥64/rhs_scale 目前必 None → create_dot_scaled(microscaling 路径，点到即止)

③ combine_fn→region 路径：core.reduce 建 make_combine_region 闭包 → semantic.reduction 建 create_reduce op → 回调 make_combine_region：开 block、_generator.call_JitFunction(combine_fn) 把其 AST 再编译进 region、create_reduce_ret → reduce_op.verify → 包结果 tensor
④ scan 路径：core.associative_scan 同③但 create_scan(带 reverse)/create_scan_ret
⑤ argmax/argmin 路径：standard.max(return_indices=True) → core._reduce_with_indices 造 index 并 broadcast → reduce((input,index), _argmax_combine…) → combine_fn 内 core.where 同步挑值+索引
⑥ histogram 路径：core.histogram → semantic.histogram(1D+int 校验) → create_histogram，无 combine region

design_decisions.decision: min_dot_size 由后端(codegen_fns)声明，而非语言层硬编码
design_decisions.why: Tensor Core 能接受的最小 tile 是硬件/后端相关的（NVIDIA int8 需 N≥32、其余 16³；AMD、interpreter 各不同）。语言层只在 semantic.dot 里 assert 存在并据其门禁，把硬件事实下沉到后端——你的 block 形状不达标就直接编译期报错，落不到 Tensor Core

design_decisions.decision: f32×f32 默认走 tf32 而非 ieee（除非无 tf32 支持或 TRITON_F32_DEFAULT 覆盖）
design_decisions.why: tf32 命中 Tensor Core（性能），ieee 退化到更慢但更精确的路径。默认偏性能，把选择权以 input_precision/allow_tf32/环境变量三层暴露给用户

design_decisions.decision: combine_fn 不在 Python 里被调用求值，而是被 fn.parse() 取 AST 后由 CodeGenerator 重新编译进 create_reduce/create_scan 的 region body
design_decisions.why: 归约/扫描的逐元素组合逻辑必须落进设备 IR 才能在 GPU 上并行执行；因此 combine_fn 只能用 tl.* 可追踪操作（core.where/maximum/+ 等），普通 Python 运算无法被 trace。这是 ch01/ch03 CodeGenerator/visit_Call 机制的高级用法

design_decisions.decision: argmax/argmin 复用同一 reduce 基础设施，靠『把索引作为第二个 tensor 一起归约』实现
design_decisions.why: 无需为带索引归约另造 IR op；_reduce_with_indices 造 arange 索引并 broadcast 到输入形状，combine_fn 内用 core.where(gt, ...) 对 (值,索引) 同步选择即得 argmax

design_decisions.decision: max_num_imprecise_acc 只对 fp8×fp8→fp32 在 sm_90 生效，默认 2**30(sm90)/0(其它)
design_decisions.why: sm_90 的 fp8 MMA 累加器有精度上限，允许每若干步刷新一次高精度累加；非 fp8 或非 sm90 无此需求故为 0

design_decisions.decision: acc 累加器缺省时由 create_splat(0) 生成，且强制 acc.type == ret_ty
design_decisions.why: 累加初值必须与输出块同形同 dtype，避免用户传入不相容 acc 破坏 MMA 累加语义

theory: Tensor Core 命中判据（本章性能落点）：tl.dot 命中 Tensor Core ⇔ 同时满足 (a) 形状 M,N,K 各 ≥ 后端 min_dot_size 对应分量（NVIDIA 非 int8 为 16/16/16，int8 为 16/32/16）；(b) input_precision 选 tf32/tf32x3 而非 ieee（f32 输入时；tf32 走 TC，ieee 退化 FMA 式更慢路径）；(c) 操作数 dtype 属受支持集合且 acc/out_dtype 相容。三者任一不满足即编译期报错或退化——读者据此自查 dot 写法。回指 ch02 硬件层解释 min_dot_size 为何存在（一句话），不重讲 warp/SIMT/TC 原理。
min_dot_size 返回三元组语义：(M_min, N_min, K_min)。注意 semantic.dot 的校验用 lhs.shape[-2]≥min[0](M)、rhs.shape[-1]≥min[1](N)、lhs.shape[-1]≥min[2](K)——下标次序易错，K 对应 min_dot_size 的第 3 分量。
combine_fn 结合律要求：associative_scan 名字点破——combine_fn 必须满足结合律（a⊕b）⊕c=a⊕(b⊕c)，因为并行前缀扫描按树形而非顺序求值；reduce 亦然。源码不强制检查，是使用契约。

reduce/scan 的 region 双入参协议：prototype = function_type(in_scalar_tys, in_scalar_tys*2)——combine_fn 接收『两组标量』(各 N 个 tensor 的一对)，返回一组，故参数个数是输入 tensor 数的 2 倍。这解释了 _argmax_combine 为何是 (value1,index1,value2,index2)→(v,i) 的四入二出。
